thread:
jordan: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — root cause still KV eviction under client burst. Need concrete remediation owners and tests. Suggest: 1) regression suite case that reproduces burst, 2) promptset to catch quality regressions under retry, 3) an autoscaler load test, 4) a short chaos drill for node eviction. Who can pick items?
maya: I can take the regression case and write a failing test first. ETA end of week? :spiral_calendar:
jordan: @maya great. Please create a ticket and link it here. Name it something like 'regression-kv-burst-repro'.
maya: Created INF-4920 and added failing test skeleton. pinging @tom for promptset work.
tom: I can build the promptset — need examples of requests that hit long context + retries. Can @olivia share logs/snippets?
olivia: dropping sample log lines below — trimmed for readability:
```
2026-03-15T02:14:08Z svc=frontend req_id=abc123 seq_len=1820 client_conn=150 burst=12 retries=2
2026-03-15T02:14:09Z svc=runtime evict: shard=3 reason=kv_pressure
```
Use the first line to craft prompt variants with repeated prefix warmups.
tom: perfect, I'll assemble ~20 prompt variants and a small eval harness that runs against the dedicated staging pool. Target Monday.
jordan: For load test, propose we add a steady-state + spike scenario mirroring the client: steady rps=200 with 10s spikes to 1500 for 30s every 10 mins. @olivia can you help parameterize the runner?
olivia: Yup. I'll add a scenario to our load repo and tag it 'kv-burst-pattern'. Also will add a guard to ensure autoscaler policy is exercised.
jordan: chaos drill — short plan: pick one pod + simulate out-of-memory eviction for 5 mins during a scheduled load run. Who wants to run the drill?
maya: I can coordinate the drill ops and runbooks. Will schedule a 45-min window next Thurs.
jordan: Ownership matrix so far: regression = @maya (INF-4920), promptset + eval harness = @tom (INF-4921 placeholder), load test scenario = @olivia (INF-4922), chaos drill coordination = @maya (INF-4923). I'll add these to the postmortem swimlane.
infra-bot: Ticket INF-4921 created by tom. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4921
infra-bot: Ticket INF-4922 created by olivia. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4922
maya: Also adding a recurring monitoring alert to detect this pattern: if 5+ evictions in 10m with concurrent client_conn > 100 trigger a pager. Assigning to eng-sre.
jordan: Good call. Can someone own the alert runbook? @olivia?
olivia: I'll draft the runbook and propose play steps. Will sync with eng-sre this week.
tom: once promptset is ready, can we add it to the daily regression job so we get early detection?
maya: yes — marking as a blocking dependency in INF-4920.
jordan: Timeline recap: regression failing test by Fri, promptset + harness by Mon, load scenario by Mon, chaos drill next Thu, runbook + alert by EoW. I'll update the postmortem doc with these owners and dates.
maya: ack.
olivia: ack.
tom: ack — will PR the promptset to the evals repo and tag reviewers. :thumbsup:
